topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't help but think about how strange the world is, to have stumbled upon you, a familiar face in the vast digital expanse, only to realize we're neighbors under the same sky. It's a small world, they say, but it feels smaller now, more intimate and somehow... heavier. I wonder what you think, finding out we share more than just exchanges through glowing screens. I keep replaying our conversations, each word now layered with the knowledge of our proximity. I hope this brings us closer, not just physically but in the way that truly matters. Let’s see where this unexpected twist leads us.
